authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (a decision that affects future interpretation is written to Tier 4), §9.5 (outputs reproducible from documented inputs), §12.1 (an output names its inputs and flags its assumptions), §12.2 (the four status categories; every ledger claim stays Unresolved), §13.3 (no project fact is invented), §15 (a declared gap over a fabricated completion). Spec decisions 8, 14 and 15 and ticket PE-07. Not a constitutional amendment.
decision: The integrity audit reads the work-package header by one label-aware rule instead of by label blocks. A header field is '<label> <value>', and the labels are looked for in the order the application form fixes them, each only after the label before it. A paragraph is a header only if it opens with a label. This reads both layouts the extraction produces: one paragraph per label, and every label of a header run into one paragraph. The audit also folds typographic ligatures before it compares or searches, and cuts every value and every piece of evidence out of the candidate's own text through an offset map, so a ligature changes what matches and never what a finding reports.
why: The revised sanitised candidate re-typesets page 45 and runs every WP4 header label into the 'WP Number: 4' block. The block-splitting parser saw six work packages instead of seven and reported WP4 as described by no block, which produced 23 downstream findings over deliverables, milestones, risks and DC projects whose single cause was the parse. Those findings were misleading: WP4's number, title, timing, lead participant, participants and DCs are all explicitly stated on that paragraph. msca-dn-pe03-resolved-fixes-revision_2026-10-06 recorded the collapse and left the parser to a PE-07 change. This is that change.

rule.general_not_special_cased: No rule in the parser names WP4, page 45, or this candidate. The label table and the ordering are the whole rule, and they hold for any work package of any document.
rule.why_the_order_is_the_rule: Searching for a label only after the label before it means a value that happens to carry a later label's word cannot be read as that label. The combined 'Start month - End month' label is tried before the standalone months because it spans both of their words.
rule.the_header_precedes_the_task_list: Once a block's task list has begun, a paragraph that merely opens with a label word is body prose: it may fill a field the header left unset, never replaces one, and no disagreement is reported. Without this, the task-description sentence 'Objectives include:' inside WP4 read as a second declaration of Objectives.
rule.ambiguity_is_reported_not_guessed: A timing value that yields no month pair, a WP Number value carrying more than a number, and a field declared twice with two different values are each recorded on the block and surfaced as an unparsed_cell finding that quotes the header paragraph. Nothing is inferred and no missing value is supplied.

ligatures.where: Every comparison and search of the module: the table-heading normaliser, the content-word tokeniser the risk check links prose by, the header labels, the DC-project patterns, the mitigation pattern.
ligatures.what_is_preserved: Original text, source offsets, assertion locations and candidate hashes. Folding lengthens the string, so a match over the folded form is mapped back through an offset map and the value is sliced out of the candidate's own text. The revised candidate's WP4 lead reads 'Academic Bene' + U+FB01 + 'ciary E' in the report, as the page spells it.
ligatures.measured_elsewhere: The import's fidelity register measures which ligatures the page texts carry (known_extraction_limitations.ligatures) and now records that the audit folds them under read_by.

manifest_register_pointer_fix.what_was_wrong: render_manifest emitted fidelity_register_derived_half from the module-level REGISTER_REL, which is the first revision's register. The revised manifest therefore pointed a reader at measurements of the first revision's pages while its own candidate block named its own register.
manifest_register_pointer_fix.fix: The field is rendered from revision.register_rel, so each revision points at its own register. The first revision's manifest is byte-identical, because its own register is the file the constant named.

what_remains_measured_as_a_limitation.wp4_header_collapse: Still measured and still recorded. What changed is that the audit reads it; a reader that splits on label blocks alone is still subject to the consequence, and the register's read_by field says who reads it and how.
